tools.name: list_materials
tools.description: Lists the active mirror and glass materials with thickness, size limits (cm) and a gross "price from" (50×70 cm rectangle, polished edge, no options) in the shop currency. Use the slug in quote_mirror.

tools.name: list_options
tools.description: Lists the shapes (with the fields each needs and, for a material, its size limits), edges, tempering, LED lighting (colour temperatures, frontlit patterns per shape), heating mat, switches and holes, with the gross "+X" price of each paid option. Paid options are only added when the customer asks.

tools.name: quote_mirror
tools.description: Prices one mirror exactly as the shop does: product gross price with its option lines, weight, delivery methods with rate-table prices (add postalCode for a delivery estimate), the cheapest total, the delivery window and whether it can be ordered. An estimate: the binding price is shown at checkout

tools.name: create_design_link
tools.description: Saves the priced mirror as a design on lustrix.eu and returns two links: the configurator (to review or change it) and the checkout (to order it), plus the same price block as quote_mirror.
